paragraphs: Rubicon sells waste and recycling services, along with sustainability and specialty services, to customers that range from national brands to households. The company describes itself as a waste sciences and recycling solutions partner that helps businesses of all sizes simplify, optimize, and improve their environmental operations. Waste and recycling services run through a network of vendor and hauler partners, and subject matter experts manage commodity markets and zero-waste programs.

Buyers named on these pages include enterprises, small and independent businesses, and contractors, DIYers, and home remodelers. Programs listed cover cardboard, plastic, paper, metal, glass, electronics recycling, construction and demolition, and organics recycling including food waste and composting services.

A single platform is offered for tracking service levels, equipment, pickups, and costs across locations. The pages also describe advisory work covering site audits, material recovery plans, and zero waste program design.
